leaderboard.source: Artificial Analysis - GDPval-AA leaderboard (Elo on OpenAI's GDPval dataset)
leaderboard.note: Elo from blind pairwise comparisons of model outputs on GDPval knowledge-work tasks. Levels carry no information in isolation - only differences do - and the comparison pool contains no human, so the scale has no absolute anchor. Elo is frozen per pool version; records from different pool versions must never be compared. Entries are per effort setting: the same model at two reasoning efforts is two records with two Elos.

expertWinRate.source: OpenAI - GDPval, wins + ties against industry experts on the 220-task gold subset
expertWinRate.metric: wins+ties vs industry experts, percent of tasks
expertWinRate.parityNote: The 50% line is NOT parity on this axis. These are wins PLUS ties, so a tie counts for the model. True parity is 50% wins-only, where GPT-5.2 Thinking sits at 49.7%.
expertWinRate.selfReportedNote: GPT-5.2 Thinking's figure is OpenAI reporting on OpenAI's own benchmark.
expertWinRate.measurementGapNote: Nothing has been published since December 2025. The shaded region is a gap in the instrument, not a statement about capability, and no trend is extended into it.
